english.title: For gain / to cause loss possess an Olympic symbol / motto / protected word made to produce goods
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(3)(b) and (5) of the Olympic Symbol etc. (Protection) Act 1995.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
with a view to gain for self / another or
with intent to cause loss to another and without the consent of the proprietor
possess an article specifically designed / adapted
for making copies of
a representation of an Olympic symbol / motto / protected word
knowing / having reason to believe that it has been / is to be
used to produce goods / material
for labelling / packaging goods
as a business paper in relation to goods / for advertising goods

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
